_comment: This node observes the HOME fleet. It has no FRR ring, no LibreNMS,
no PBS and no peer O-node, so those rows are omitted rather than
probed: a target this node cannot see must not be asked about.
Absent this file the client falls back to virp-lab's battery, which
host_device and fortigate_device probe the hypervisor this node runs
on and the edge in front of it, using the exact-match GREEN spellings
in driver_linux.c and driver_fortigate.c. Liveness reads: a GREEN,
verified response IS the finding, so they add no baseline.
baselines is EMPTY on purpose. The Wazuh agent count here has never
been agreed, and adopting the colo figures would alert every cycle
against a number nobody chose. Populate it from observed cycles once
the intended count is decided, in its own commit.
